Academics

I am New
I am Next
I am Better

Empowering the Future: At Seth M.R. Jaipuria Schools, we nurture creativity, leadership, and personal growth through holistic programs and innovative learning experiences.

Academics and Innovation

Self-Learning Focus: Our curriculum promotes self-learning, where content serves as a pathway to growth, not the final goal.

Inquiry-Driven Learning

Students are fostered to a deeper quest for knowledge.

Intrinsic Motivation

Learning is driven from within! an emphasis on curiosity and personal engagement empahsising on critical thinking and problem solving.

Developing Integrity

Students take responsibility for their learning, gaining control over thoughts and actions.

Reimagining Schooling

Our curriculum encourages students to engage in inquiry-based learning for future exploration.

Jaipuria Schools and the National Education Policy 2020

NEP 2020 Vision

Aims to revolutionise India’s education system with a focus on holistic, flexible, and multidisciplinary learning to position India as a global knowledge leader.

Key Focus Areas

Emphasises early childhood care, foundational literacy, inclusive education, teacher training, and technology integration.

Holistic Education

Jaipuria Schools align with NEP by prioritising character-building, leadership, and value-based education.

Inclusive & Flexible Curriculum

The schools promote an inclusive approach with a flexible curriculum, supporting diverse learning needs, in line with NEP goals.

Teacher Development

A strong focus on teacher training and professional development, in line with NEP’s emphasis on enhancing educator quality.

Technology Integration

Jaipuria Schools embrace technology in classrooms, aligning with NEP’s vision of a tech-driven education system.

Our Values

SPICE shapes Brilliance and Humanity!! We are here to inspire our community to live with purpose, compassion, and global responsibility.

Sustainability

Advocating sustainable practices to ensure the longevity of ourselves and our environment.

Possibility

Promoting a mindset that embraces possibility thinking as a fundamental belief in our lives.

Integrity

Upholding moral values in all situations, fostering a strong sense of integrity among students and staff.

Collaboration

Encouraging teamwork and prioritizing collaboration over individual pursuits.

Empathy

Cultivating the ability to relate to and connect with others, empowering and inspiring lives through empathy.

Regular training and textbook integration ensure SPICE principles are seamlessly embedded in daily school life.

Ongoing feedback from students, parents, and staff refines strategies,

Fostering academic growth
and strong values.

This transformative approach equips students with ethics and excellence for future success.

Stage-Wise Educational Framework Infographic Data

Foundational Stage

(Nursery to Grade 2)

Teacher modeling, structured learning. curiosity stimulation

Model concepts, guide structured learning

Learn through guided assessments

Preparatory Stage

(Grades 3 to 5)

Activity-based learning, self-discovery, inquiry-driven lessons

Model concepts, encourage exploration

Explore independently, take responsibility

Middle Stage

(Grades 6 to 8)

Student-led learning, critical questioning. independent inquiry

Facilitate, empower students' inquiry

Take ownership, construct knowledge

Secondary Stage

(Grades 9 to 12)

Critical thinking, multidisciplinary approaches, leadership skills

Guide inquiry, prepare for careers

Self-directed learning, connect subjects

Empowering Education Together

Holistic training programs fostering excellence in education. From upskilling teachers to enhancing leadership and innovation, we empower educators, leaders, and students to thrive and drive meaningful change.

Induction

A year-long self-paced program for new teachers to understand Jaipuria curriculum and pedagogy via JLearn.

Need Based

Targeted training to address skill gaps and challenges, enhancing motivation and performance for continuous improvement.

Upskill

Annual training to enhance teaching skills with technology, project-based learning, and hands-on activities for better outcomes.

Rendezvous

Reconnect, reminisce, and relive the golden days at Rendezvous—the alumni meet of Seth M.R. Jaipuria School. Celebrate memories, cherish bonds, and create new moments to treasure forever!

T2T Enrichment Training

Cascade-mode training for teachers to upskill and mentor peers in pedagogical areas.

IDEAL 2.0

Fosters interdisciplinary learning for Grades 1-8 through hands-on projects, integrating subjects like Science, Mathematics, and Art to build critical skills.

Sanskrit Training

Focused sessions enhance teachers’ skills with innovative methodologies for effective Sanskrit teaching.

Baithak

A collaborative capacity-building program fostering teamwork and innovation through S.P.I.C.E values, aimed at cohesive corporate development.

JLP (Jaipuria Leadership Program)

Empowering school leaders with innovative strategies and professional skills to adapt and lead effectively.

Jaipuria Examination Enhancement & Training (JEET)

A structured board exam preparation program focusing on MCQs, critical thinking, and adaptability for Classes X and XII.

JAIP (Jaipuria Annual Ideation Program)

Professional development program for counselors and staff, ensuring seamless integration into roles and fostering collective success.

Benchmark Assessment

Empowering school leaders with innovative strategies and professional skills to adapt and lead effectively.

Summer Leap

A week-long summer program engaging students and parents in creative activities like yoga, theatre, nutrition workshops, and parenting tips, fostering learning and fun during vacations.
